description: Truncate a caller-selected document without checking its location or purpose.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary document maintenance, not an evolutionary algorithm. The operation edits a file in place and has no candidate scoring or reproduction. os.truncate clears the contents of a caller-selected path without validating it. Policy basis: This filesystem capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
